title: Device
description: One southbound device stored as devices/{metadata.id}.yaml. M1 adapters are Fanuc only.

id.description: Stable device id. Must match the file name and the MQTT {deviceId} segment.

adapter.description: fanuc.fake needs no hardware. fanuc.focas is the Windows x64 Fwlib64 P/Invoke path; the vendor DLL is not in this repo.

enabled.description: Disabled devices are not acquired and are omitted from the online count.

intervalMs.description: Scan interval for this device. Overrides Gateway.spec.acquisition.defaultIntervalMs.

pointTemplateId.description: Point template shared by devices of the same class. Fanuc devices (fanuc.fake and fanuc.focas) reference a template whose spec.adapter is fanuc. Required for Fanuc devices before publish. Optional per-device overrides live in points/{metadata.id}.yaml.

host.description: Panel IPv4/IPv6 address or host name. Maps from legacy devices[].options.host.

port.description: FOCAS Ethernet port. 8193 is the usual panel port.

focasTimeoutMs.description: Connect timeout in milliseconds. The FOCAS call rounds this up to whole seconds (cnc_allclibhndl3). Maps from legacy options.timeoutMs.
